title: Autonomous Solar-Panel Cleaning Robot
description: SolarCleano's F1A is an autonomous dry-cleaning robot for photovoltaic arrays. Manufacturer documentation specifies a 1200 mm brush, movement up to 25 m/min, four hours of battery operation, and a 20-degree climbing capability.
